note: Fixed general-drawing evaluation suite (docs/exec-plans/active/general-drawing.md, Phase 5). Topics and required features were written before any prompt-v4 work and must not be tuned against. Calibrated once after the 8-topic v3 pilot (2026-10-19): wave-standing no longer requires `plot`, because a string diagram without axes is a correct board. `requires` lists what a teacher's board for the topic must show, from a closed vocabulary checked on the compiled scene: plot (a frame with axes), curve (function-like curve), region (shaded area), round (circle, ellipse, or arc), polygon (closed straight shape), vector (arrow), angle (angle marker), point (marked point), line (straight segment). `name:n` means at least n.
